status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Search and select a company by ticker
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can enter a ticker, choose a company, and load its analysis workspace.
verification: Open the app.
Enter a valid ticker such as AAPL in the search input.
Submit or select the result.
Verify the app loads the selected company's workspace.

features.title: Display a company overview dashboard
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees the selected company's name, ticker, sector, price, market cap, and a concise business summary.
verification: Load a company workspace.
Verify the dashboard shows company identity fields.
Verify price and market cap are visible.
Verify a business summary is shown in the overview panel.

features.title: Show key financial metrics for the selected company
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees important financial details such as revenue, EPS, free cash flow, margins, and return metrics.
verification: Load a company workspace.
Open the financial details section.
Verify key metrics such as revenue, EPS, and free cash flow are displayed.
Verify at least one profitability or return metric is shown.

features.title: Render historical financial charts
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view clean historical charts for revenue, earnings, and cash flow trends.
verification: Load a company workspace.
Navigate to the chart section.
Verify at least three historical charts render.
Verify the charts update when a different company is selected.

features.title: Calculate intrinsic value with a DCF model
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can enter DCF assumptions and see an intrinsic value estimate update from those inputs.
verification: Load a company workspace.
Open the DCF calculator.
Enter or modify growth, discount rate, and terminal assumptions.
Verify the intrinsic value output updates after the changes.

features.title: Show valuation sensitivity for DCF assumptions
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can see how the DCF result changes across assumption ranges in a sensitivity table or grid.
verification: Open the DCF calculator for a company.
Locate the sensitivity section.
Verify the table or grid shows different outcomes across multiple assumptions.
Verify changing a core assumption updates the sensitivity output.

features.title: Calculate intrinsic value with a dividend discount model
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can use a DDM calculator for dividend-paying companies and compare the resulting valuation.
verification: Load a dividend-paying company workspace.
Open the DDM calculator.
Enter or modify dividend growth and discount assumptions.
Verify the DDM intrinsic value output is shown.

features.title: Generate an AI investment analysis for the selected company
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can request an AI analysis and see a structured summary covering business quality, risks, and valuation context.
verification: Load a company workspace.
Open the AI analysis panel.
Trigger analysis generation.
Verify the response includes sections for thesis, risks, and valuation context.

features.title: Ground AI analysis with visible evidence
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can inspect the evidence or source data behind the AI analysis instead of seeing an unsupported summary.
verification: Generate an AI analysis for a company.
Open the evidence or support section.
Verify the UI shows the inputs, data points, or citations used by the analysis.
Verify the evidence shown matches the selected company.

features.title: Save and reload valuation scenarios
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can save a valuation scenario and load it again later without re-entering assumptions.
verification: Open a valuation calculator for a company.
Change several assumptions.
Save the scenario.
Reload the page or restart the app.
Verify the saved scenario can be loaded and the assumptions are restored.

features.title: Handle loading, invalid tickers, and API failures gracefully
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees clear loading states and understandable error messages instead of blank screens or broken components.
verification: Search for a valid ticker and verify loading indicators appear while data is fetched.
Search for an invalid ticker and verify a clear error message is shown.
Simulate or trigger a backend failure.
Verify the app shows a recoverable error state instead of crashing.
